mapper.select: select count(1) from te_group where ai_ref_score is not null
select count(1) from te_score where is_published = 1

select r.id, r.level, r.content, r.progress, r.send_time as sendTime, c.class_name as className, g.group_name as groupName from te_warning_record r left join te_class c on c.id = r.class_id left join te_group g on g.id = r.group_id where r.resolved = 0 order by r.send_time desc limit 5

select g.id as groupId, g.group_name as groupName, g.submit_status as submitStatus, g.ai_ref_score as aiRefScore, (select count(1) from te_module_content mc where mc.group_id = g.id and mc.status = 2) as submitted, (select t.deadline from te_task_assign a left join te_task t on t.id = a.task_id where a.group_id = g.id order by a.id limit 1) as deadline, (select t.task_name from te_task_assign a left join te_task t on t.id = a.task_id where a.group_id = g.id order by a.id limit 1) as taskName from te_group g where g.class_id = #{classId} order by g.group_order

select t.`range` as `range`, count(1) as `cnt` from ( select case when s.final_score >= 90 then '90-100' when s.final_score >= 80 then '80-89' when s.final_score >= 60 then '60-79' else '60以下' end as `range` from te_score s join te_student st on st.user_id = s.user_id where s.class_id = #{classId} and s.is_published = 1 ) t group by t.`range`
select count(1) from te_group where class_id = #{classId} and submit_status = 1
select count(1) from te_module_content where group_id = #{groupId} and status = 2
select count(1) from te_confirm_record where group_id = #{groupId} and user_id = #{userId} and confirm_type = 2
select final_score from te_score where user_id = #{userId} and is_published = 1
select user_id from te_student where group_id = #{groupId}
